meta.title: Improve start command reload behavior
meta.body_summary: Adjust gensx start command for non-TTY environments, keep CLI running on build errors instead of exiting, add console logging in quiet/non-TTY mode, and fix linter issues.

perf_labels.notes: Codex CLI reload improvement; cursor bot flagged logging bugs, author fixed duplicate logs then closed PR without merge.
